全球气候变化与国家安全: Global Climate Change and National Security
马尔代夫为什么要把内阁会议开到 6 米深的海底去？: Why did the Maldives hold a cabinet meeting 6 meters under the sea?
化石燃料 + 土地利用：两条人为输入把碳送回大气: Fossil fuels + land use: two human inputs send carbon back into the atmosphere

中间的海盆：表层 900、深海 37 800 PgC，是最大的活跃库: The ocean basin in the middle: surface 900, deep ocean 37 800 PgC, the largest active reservoir
右侧厂房与烟囱：化石燃料与工业过程排放的入口: Factories and chimneys on the right: the entry point for fossil fuel and industrial emissions
海里的小岛与海平面刻度：国土最高海拔不足 5 米: A small island in the sea with a sea-level scale: its highest land is under 5 m above sea level
碳在大气、海洋和陆地之间，本来是怎么转的？: How did carbon originally move between the atmosphere, ocean and land?
拖动视角把整片景观看一圈：蓝实箭头是自然界的吸收与排放，成对进出: Drag the view around the whole landscape: solid blue arrows are natural uptake and release, going in and out in pairs
库的大小：大气 589、植被 550、土壤 1950、表层海洋 900、深海 3: Reservoir sizes: atmosphere 589, vegetation 550, soil 1950, surface ocean 900, deep ocean 37 800 PgC; natural arrows come in pairs, one in and one out
自然界的碳循环（库大小按对数压缩）: The natural carbon cycle (reservoir sizes compressed logarithmically)
浓度长期稳定: Concentration stable over the long term
碳循环是指碳元素在大气圈、水圈、生物圈以及岩石圈之间迁移、转化所构成的循环。: The carbon cycle is the cycling of carbon as it moves and transforms between the atmosphere, hydrosphere, biosphere and lithosphere.
大气中的二氧化碳通过光合作用被陆地和海洋中的植物吸收，再通过呼吸和分解过程返回大: Carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is taken up by plants on land and in the ocean through photosynthesis, and returns to the atmosphere through respiration and decomposition.
收支大体相抵，所以自然界的碳循环维持了大气中二氧化碳等温室气体含量的相对稳定。: Uptake and release roughly balance, so the natural carbon cycle keeps the content of greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide in the atmosphere relatively stable.
去掉这一步：学生只在「大气 ↔ 树叶」之间看碳循环，把海洋和土壤两个大库漏掉。: Skip this step and students see the carbon cycle only between "air ↔ leaves", leaving out the two big reservoirs of ocean and soil.
易错：碳循环只在大气与生物之间（正确：大气圈、水圈、生物圈、岩石圈四者之间）。: Common mistake: the carbon cycle only between atmosphere and living things (correct: among the atmosphere, hydrosphere, biosphere and lithosphere).
碳在大气圈、水圈、生物圈、岩石圈之间迁移转化；自然界的碳循环维持了大气中二氧化碳: Carbon moves and transforms among the atmosphere, hydrosphere, biosphere and lithosphere; the natural carbon cycle keeps greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide in the atmosphere relatively stable.

人类是从哪两个口子往里加碳的？: Through which two openings do humans add carbon?
把「土地利用变化排放」从 1.6 拖到 5.0：森林边那支红色细虚线变粗，大气库: Drag "land-use change emissions" from 1.6 to 5.0: the thin dashed red line by the forest thickens, and the atmospheric increase grows with it
年排放 11.0 → 14.4 PgC/a；累积 550 → 720；大气增量: Annual emissions 11.0 → 14.4 PgC/a; cumulative 550 → 720; atmospheric increase 242 → 316.8, absorbed 308 → 403.2; concentration 392.2 → 427.4 ppm; equilibrium warming 1.489 → 1.862 ℃
工业革命以来的两条人为途径: Two human pathways since the Industrial Revolution
工业革命以来，人类活动主要通过使用化石燃料和改变土地利用两种方式极大地改变了全球: Since the Industrial Revolution, human activity has greatly altered the global carbon cycle mainly in two ways: burning fossil fuels and changing land use.
化石燃料的使用，把漫长地质时期固定的碳以二氧化碳等形式重新释放到大气中。: Burning fossil fuels releases carbon fixed over long geological periods back into the atmosphere as carbon dioxide and other forms.
森林砍伐和焚烧、农田开垦等土地利用变化，把陆地植被和土壤中的碳释放到大气中。: Land-use changes such as cutting and burning forests and clearing farmland release carbon from vegetation and soil into the atmosphere.
去掉这一步：学生会以为排放只有烟囱，森林那一路的人为箭头就看不见了。: Skip this step and students think emissions come only from chimneys, missing the human arrow from forests.
易错：认为砍树只影响景观（正确：把植被和土壤中的碳以 CO₂ 形式释放到大气）。: Common mistake: thinking felling trees only affects scenery (correct: it releases carbon from vegetation and soil into the atmosphere as CO₂).
人为输入只有两条：化石燃料的使用与土地利用的变化；它们把原本固定在岩石、植被与土: There are only two human inputs: burning fossil fuels and changing land use; they send carbon once fixed in rock, vegetation and soil back into the atmosphere.
facts A2.2、A7-5；B2.1 ①、标准值表「土地利用上限」: facts A2.2, A7-5; B2.1 ①, standard values table "land-use maximum"
排出去的碳，最后都留在大气里了吗？: Does all the carbon emitted stay in the atmosphere?
把「大气留存比例」从 0.44 拖到 0.20（相当于增汇）：看两处增量怎么此消: Drag "airborne fraction" from 0.44 to 0.20 (equivalent to enhancing sinks): see how the two increases trade off
累积仍是 550 PgC：大气增量 242 → 110、海洋与陆地吸收 308: Cumulative still 550 PgC: atmospheric increase 242 → 110, ocean and land uptake 308 → 440; concentration 392.2 → 329.9 ppm, equilibrium warming 1.489 → 0.741 ℃; drag to 0.70 and warming is 2.176 ℃
人类排放到大气中的二氧化碳，部分通过碳循环过程被海洋和陆地吸收，其余部分会在大气: Of the carbon dioxide humans emit into the atmosphere, part is absorbed by the ocean and land through the carbon cycle, and the rest stays in the atmosphere for a long time.
这正是大气中二氧化碳含量不断增加、而不是「排多少涨多少」的原因。: That is why atmospheric carbon dioxide keeps rising, but not "by exactly as much as is emitted".
留存比例基准是观测值 0.44（观测区间 0.38–0.50）；把它拖低相当于教: The baseline airborne fraction is the observed 0.44 (observed range 0.38–0.50); dragging it lower corresponds to what the textbook calls "enhancing sinks".
去掉这一步：学生会以为「排多少、大气里就多多少」——本课最高频的错。: Skip this step and students think "however much is emitted, that much is added to the air", the most frequent mistake in this lesson.
易错：认为排放的 CO₂ 全留在大气里；也易错在把「被吸收」当成「消失了」。: Common mistake: thinking all emitted CO₂ stays in the atmosphere; another is taking "absorbed" to mean "gone".
排放不是全留在大气：部分被海洋和陆地吸收、其余在大气中长期停留；留存比例越低（增: Not all emissions stay in the atmosphere: part is absorbed by the ocean and land and the rest stays for a long time; the lower the airborne fraction (enhanced sinks), the slower concentration and warming rise.
facts A2.2 主判据、A7-6；B2.1 ②、B2.4 D5/D8、标准: facts A2.2 main criterion, A7-6; B2.1 ②, B2.4 D5/D8, standard values table "airborne fraction minimum / maximum"
大气里的碳变多，怎么会变成更暖？: More carbon in the air: how does it make things warmer?
看 12 秒：大气里的温室气体层变浓、射向宇宙的长波变细，三块链条牌「浓度升高: Watch for 12 s: the greenhouse gas layer in the air thickens, outgoing longwave to space thins, and three chain cards "higher concentration → positive radiative forcing → equilibrium warming" light up in turn
温室气体层出现、出射长波变细（示意）；读数：浓度 392.2 ppm → 辐射强: A greenhouse gas layer appears and outgoing longwave thins (illustrative); readings: concentration 392.2 ppm → radiative forcing 1.841 W/m² → equilibrium warming 1.489 ℃; forcing for doubled CO₂ 3.708 W/m², equilibrium climate sensitivity 3.0 ℃ → conversion factor 0.809 ℃/(W/m²)
大气中的水汽、二氧化碳、甲烷等温室气体强烈吸收地面长波辐射，使地球接收的太阳能不: Greenhouse gases in the atmosphere such as water vapor, carbon dioxide and methane strongly absorb the ground's longwave radiation, so the solar energy Earth receives is not lost at once: this is the greenhouse effect.
工业革命以来的人类活动使温室效应增强，被认为是 20 世纪以来全球变暖的主要原因: Human activity since the Industrial Revolution has enhanced the greenhouse effect, considered the main cause of global warming since the 20th century.
浓度升高 → 辐射强迫为正 → 平衡升温为正；本课的 1.489 ℃ 是平衡升温: Higher concentration → positive radiative forcing → positive equilibrium warming; this lesson's 1.489 ℃ is equilibrium warming, not the actual temperature in any particular year.
去掉这一步：浓度和升温成了两个没有关系的读数，课标要的「运用温室效应原理」就落不: Skip this step and concentration and warming become two unrelated readings, and the curriculum's "apply the principle of the greenhouse effect" never lands.
易错：把温室效应说成臭氧层问题；也易错在把平衡升温当成「届时气温」。: Common mistake: calling the greenhouse effect an ozone layer problem; another is taking equilibrium warming as "the temperature by then".
温室气体吸收地面长波、把已经进来的太阳能留住；浓度升高使辐射强迫为正，换算成平衡: Greenhouse gases absorb ground longwave and hold onto solar energy that has already come in; higher concentration makes radiative forcing positive, which converts into positive equilibrium warming (this lesson excludes ocean thermal inertia).
排放一直这么跑下去，会跑到哪？: If emissions keep running like this, where do they end up?
把「观察年数」从 50 年拖到 100 年：曲线上的点沿着线往右走，直到钻进 2: Drag "years observed" from 50 to 100: the point on the curve moves right along the line until it enters the red 2 ℃ band
累积排放 550 → 1100 PgC；浓度 392.2 → 506.3 ppm: Cumulative emissions 550 → 1100 PgC; concentration 392.2 → 506.3 ppm; forcing 1.841 → 3.207 W/m²; equilibrium warming 1.489 → 2.595 ℃, and the margin to 2 ℃ changes from +0.511 to −0.595 (over the line)
dT 随累积排放单调增: dT rises monotonically with cumulative emissions
决定升温的是累积排放（排放强度 × 年数），不是某一年的排放量。: What decides warming is cumulative emissions (emission rate × years), not the amount emitted in any one year.
同样强度、年数翻倍：累积 550 → 1100 PgC，平衡升温 1.489 →: Same rate, twice as many years: cumulative 550 → 1100 PgC and equilibrium warming 1.489 → 2.595 ℃, rising monotonically, matching the trend in textbook Fig. 3.33.
越过 2 ℃ 就进入教材说的危险阈值：气候资源空间配置改变、灾害概率上升、淡水粮: Beyond 2 ℃ is what the textbook calls the danger threshold: the spatial pattern of climate resources changes, disasters become more likely, and fresh water, food, health and urban infrastructure are threatened.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「今年少排一点就够了」。: Skip this step and students think "emitting a bit less this year is enough".
易错：把升温直接等同于某一年的排放量，忽略累积（教材活动第 1 问的方向）。: Common mistake: equating warming with one year's emissions and ignoring the cumulative total (the point of textbook activity question 1).
升温随累积排放单调增加；同样强度跑得更久，累积翻倍、平衡升温从 1.489 ℃: Warming rises monotonically with cumulative emissions; at the same rate for longer, the total doubles and equilibrium warming rises from 1.489 ℃ to 2.595 ℃, crossing the textbook's 2 ℃ danger threshold.
facts A2.3 活动第 1 问、A2.5；B2.1 ⑦、B2.4 D6/D: facts A2.3 activity question 1, A2.5; B2.1 ⑦, B2.4 D6/D7, standard values table "years observed maximum"
越过 2 ℃ 以后，一个国家会碰上什么？: Beyond 2 ℃, what does a country face?
点一下海里那座小岛：海平面刻度升起来，看看被淹掉的陆地在哪: Click the island in the sea: the sea-level scale rises; see where land is drowned
越线工况下（平衡升温 2.595 ℃、余量 −0.595），岛国陆地最高海拔不超: In the over-the-line condition (equilibrium warming 2.595 ℃, margin −0.595), the island nation's highest land is no more than 5 m above sea level: its land area already shrank 2 % from 1993 to 2009, and more than 60 % of it is expected to be under water around 2050
升温 → 海平面上升 → 生存空间丧失: Warming → sea-level rise → loss of living space
教材四类影响：生存空间 · 资源危机 · 资源争端 · 被他国波及: The textbook's four kinds of impact: living space · resource crises · resource disputes · spillover from other countries
生存空间的丧失是气候变化对国家安全最为严重的影响：马尔代夫、图瓦卢等小岛国面临被: Loss of living space is the most serious impact of climate change on national security: small island states such as the Maldives and Tuvalu risk being submerged.
第二类：加剧资源危机或自然灾害——水、耕地等战略资源数量减少、稳定性降低。: Second: worsening resource crises or natural disasters, as strategic resources such as water and farmland shrink and become less stable.
第三类：激化国家间的资源争端；第四类：受其他国家波及（环境难民、国际资源市场价格: Third: sharpening resource disputes between countries; fourth: spillover from other countries (environmental refugees, price swings in international resource markets).
去掉这一步：气候变化停在「气温数字」上，接不到「国家安全」这一层。: Skip this step and climate change stops at "a temperature number", never reaching "national security".
易错：认为气候变化的国家安全影响只有「小岛被淹」；教材给了四类，「最为严重」只标: Common mistake: thinking the national security impact of climate change is only "small islands drowning"; the textbook gives four kinds and marks only the first as "most serious".
生存空间的丧失最为严重（图瓦卢陆地最高海拔不足 5 米）；此外还有加剧资源危机或: Loss of living space is the most serious (Tuvalu's highest land is under 5 m); there are also worsening resource crises or natural disasters, sharpening resource disputes between countries, and spillover from other countries, all of which come down to national security.
facts A2.4、A3.2、A7-11；本章要点 5: facts A2.4, A3.2, A7-11; chapter key point 5
怎么把这条线压回去？: How can this line be pushed back down?
把「化石燃料与工业过程碳排放」拖到 0（只减排）：看烟囱停了、曲线整体往左下走: Drag "fossil fuel and industrial carbon emissions" to 0 (cutting emissions only): the chimneys stop and the curve moves down and to the left
年排放 11.0 → 1.6 PgC/a；累积 550 → 80；大气增量 24: Annual emissions 11.0 → 1.6 PgC/a; cumulative 550 → 80; atmospheric increase 242 → 35.2; concentration 392.2 → 294.6 ppm; equilibrium warming 1.489 → 0.251 ℃, margin +1.749 ℃; dragging the airborne fraction lower (enhancing sinks) also brings it down
减缓（减排增汇）+ 适应（趋利避害）: Mitigation (cut emissions, enhance sinks) + adaptation (seize benefits, avoid harm)
减缓有两手：减少人为温室气体排放（降低能耗、清洁能源、改善产业结构、征收碳税……: Mitigation has two hands: reducing human greenhouse gas emissions (lower energy use, clean energy, better industrial structure, carbon taxes…) and increasing greenhouse gas uptake (afforestation, less forest destruction, storage underground or in the ocean).
适应是另一条路：以趋利避害为目标，改变人类社会自身，降低不利影响或利用发展机遇。: Adaptation is another road: aiming to seize benefits and avoid harm by changing human society itself, reducing harmful effects or using development opportunities.
按 3.667 换算，参考工况 11.0 PgC/a 约合 40.4 Gt CO: Converting at 3.667, the reference 11.0 PgC/a is about 40.4 Gt CO₂/a; funding and technology are key to achieving mitigation and adaptation, and countries act on "equity" and "common but differentiated responsibilities", with developed countries cutting emissions first and supporting developing countries.
去掉这一步：学生会把「减缓」和「适应」混成一件事，也看不到国际合作的两个原则。: Skip this step and students blend "mitigation" and "adaptation" into one thing, and miss the two principles of international cooperation.
易错：以为减缓只是「少排放」（还包括增汇）；以为《巴黎协定》仍强制分配减排量（改: Common mistakes: thinking mitigation is only "emitting less" (it also includes enhancing sinks); thinking the Paris Agreement still allocates mandatory cuts (it switched to nationally determined contributions).
减缓 = 减排 + 增汇，目的是控制大气中的温室气体含量、避免气温超过危险水平；: Mitigation = cutting emissions + enhancing sinks, aiming to control atmospheric greenhouse gases and keep temperatures below dangerous levels; adaptation = seizing benefits and avoiding harm; both rely on funding, technology and international cooperation.
facts A2.6、A2.7、A3.1、A7-7/8/9/10；B2.1 ②、: facts A2.6, A2.7, A3.1, A7-7/8/9/10; B2.1 ②, standard values table "emission cuts only"
考核：把观察年数设到 100 年，并让平衡升温留在 2 ℃ 以内: Check: set years observed to 100 and keep equilibrium warming within 2 ℃
在 100 年的视野里，把平衡升温留在 2 ℃ 以内：减排压累积、增汇抬吸收，哪: Over a 100-year horizon, keep equilibrium warming within 2 ℃: cutting emissions lowers the total and enhancing sinks raises uptake; which knob pays off best?
达标的一组：化石燃料排放 5.4 PgC/a、观察 100 年 → 累积 700: One passing setting: fossil fuel emissions 5.4 PgC/a, observed 100 years → cumulative 700 PgC, concentration 423.3 ppm, forcing 2.249 W/m², equilibrium warming 1.820 ℃, margin +0.180 ℃ (not over the line); other solutions are accepted too
减排压累积 + 增汇抬吸收 → 点留在红带下: Cut emissions to lower the total + enhance sinks to raise uptake → the point stays below the red band
100 年尺度下要留在 2 ℃ 内，靠的是把累积排放压下来（减排）+ 让更多碳被: Staying within 2 ℃ over 100 years depends on lowering cumulative emissions (cutting emissions) + letting more carbon be absorbed by ocean and land (enhancing sinks).
两条路不能互相替代：只减排是极限做法，增汇能省下一部分减排量——这正是教材说减缓: The two roads cannot replace each other: cutting emissions alone is the extreme approach, and enhancing sinks can save part of the required cuts; that is why the textbook says mitigation has "two aspects".
本课模型是示意：不含碳汇饱和、海洋酸化与热惯性，真实情况更紧。: This lesson's model is illustrative: it excludes sink saturation, ocean acidification and thermal inertia, so reality is tighter.
